faq.lede: If a fifteen-year-old cannot follow the answer, the answer is wrong. Here are the short ones.
faq.a1: A small Canadian studio that builds tools to find leftover waste — extra steps, extra waiting, extra cost — the way you find a leak under a sink. We write the number down. You can check it.
faq.a2: Read. Talk to Iris, our helper. Give a research gift if you want. You do not need an account to look.
faq.a3: No. She is not a doctor, a lawyer, or a bank. She is a helper on this site. If you need care, call a real clinic.
faq.q4: Is Fuel a coin or a stock?
faq.a4: No. Fuel is prepaid minutes for our tools, like putting money on a transit card. What you do not use stays yours. It is not a share. It is not investment advice.
faq.a5: No. Looking is free. Talking to Iris is free. Giving is optional. Buying minutes is optional.
faq.q6: What if the number is wrong?
faq.a6: Then you owe nothing. If we cannot show the same figure again, the deal does not stand. That is the house rule.
faq.a7: Yes. Close the tab. Walk away. We are only useful if you choose to use us.
footer.truth: DualisCapax · Truth Prevails · a tool you can check
people.h1: You paid. The work should show up.
people.lede: Taxes and premiums already left your account. DualisCapax builds tools so a government desk, a clinic, a school, a shop, or a household can see where that money leaked — and send what they recover back into the work.
payments.lede: Stripe is retired. No Payment Links. No card form. Look is $0.
research.lede: Each room is its own pile. You do not have to read the whole site. Twelve can start with Iris. Specialists can jump to math.
lookindex.lede: See the hall. Then pick a desk. Asking is free. This is not a clinic.
audit.lede: Name a residual. Get a SHA-256 receipt on this device. Chain to the last write. No appointment. No gate except Layer [0] truth.
measure.lede: One bill. Three buckets. Walk the dollars back to the kilowatt-hours. If they don't meet, the leftover is a hole — not a fee.
schools.lede: Overtime, energy, empty rooms, procurement friction. Dualis names the residual and whether you can walk it back. Same measure engine the backend already runs — DCLM / Iris.
gateway.lede: Capacity tier, equal-CAD crypto rail, sealed slip, telemetry, parallel combos. Measure here. Money waits on live Payment Links.
onboard.h1: Set up and start modeling today
onboard.lede: Finish the five steps. You leave with a workbench on this device. If the name is yours, the number is U1. Anyone else hatches under you. Founder zero does not have to be verified first.
donate.h1: A gift with no ticket back
donate.lede: If Bind is the transit counter, this room is the jar on the shelf. You put something in because the work should keep going. You do not get a pass, a seat, or a share in return.
